sections.content: The conditional expresses hypothetical results, imagined changes and polite or tentative evaluations. For housing, it is useful when discussing what someone would change, what an ideal home would include, or how a property could be improved. It often combines with si + imperfect subjunctive for hypothetical situations.

items.spanish: Reformaría la cocina si tuviera más dinero.
items.english: I would renovate the kitchen if I had more money.

items.spanish: Ampliaría el salón para tener más espacio.
items.english: I would enlarge the living room to have more space.

items.spanish: Si pudiera elegir, viviría en una casa con jardín.
items.english: If I could choose, I would live in a house with a garden.

items.spanish: Cambiaría las ventanas porque así habría más luz.
items.english: I would change the windows because that way there would be more light.

sections.content: For standard hypothetical situations, use si + imperfect subjunctive followed by the conditional: si *tuviera*..., *reformaría*.... Do not put the conditional directly after si.
